parlays.why: He caught 11 for 117 with a long of 22 two games ago. He averaged 8.3 yards a catch at USC and still had 83 on ten catches. Indiana held him to 68. He drew 13, 9, 17 and 8 targets for 83, 133, 117 and 165 in his latest four. Michigan gave up 105 to McClellan and 101 to Moore at Oregon. Noon Columbus forecast is partly sunny with a 12 mph wind. His last four target counts were 7, 9, 10 and 12. He turned those looks into 67, 81, 62 and 93 yards. The most productive opposing tight end in Louisville’s last four games recorded 75, 34, 72 and 15 yards. He carried 22, 20, 27 and 20 times in the last four team games, going for 150, 72, 149 and 151. SMU allowed the most productive opposing back 56, 123, 77 and 98 yards in its latest four games. Derry had 7, 13, 8 and 6 targets for 70, 143, 137 and 125 yards. Barnett found him on three touchdowns against Iowa State. The top opposing wideout had 73, 103, 66 and 45 in Colorado’s last four. Derry needs 50 in a game where the forecast favors shorter throws. His carries across the latest four team games were 29, 26, 28 and 23. He gained 221, 182, 216 and 171 yards. The top opposing back had 120 and 175 against Kansas State before much smaller totals in its next two. His advantage is the number of carries Iowa State gives him. Barkate saw 5, 12, 8 and 9 targets in his most recent four team games and gained 71, 75, 134 and 72 yards. Boston College allowed opposing leading receivers 44, 86, 86 and 212 across four games. Two BC defensive backs were on the Friday out list. Last three team games: six catches for 77, five for 41 and seven for 109. Five catches for 41 with a long of 13 shows a path on short gains. Syracuse gave up 100 receiving yards to Clemson’s Wesco and 69 to NC State’s Dozier. This game is indoors. Jones started each of LSU’s first 11 games. He had 21, 17, 19 and 17 carries for 92, 56, 125 and 50 yards in the latest four. Arkansas yielded 138 and 77 to the top opposing backs in two of its last four. The other two came in at 41 and 32. Fayetteville kickoff wind is forecast around 5 mph.
parlays.risk: Backup quarterback, wind and bracket coverage can limit intermediate throws. A four-catch game left Smith below 70 at Indiana. Louisville held an opposing tight end group in check last time. Receivers Darby and Miller compete for targets. Stanford lists offensive linemen Kilstrom and Mejia out, Pale doubtful and Miller questionable. Blocking and a second-half deficit threaten his rushing work. Boulder has 20 mph wind and likely rain at kickoff. I cut the receiving milestone to 50 and would reconsider if conditions worsen. Kansas State held its last two opposing lead rushing totals at RB to 55 and 12. He needs volume and several efficient runs to get to 110. A Miami runaway could cut late targets. Malachi Toney was upgraded to doubtful and could take routes if he returns. He had three catches for only 16 against Stanford. An early Notre Dame lead could reduce second-half targets. He landed on 50 last time. Arkansas can win early downs or Leavitt can keep the ball. This also shares an offense with Green on the Daily Double.
